common.sizePrice.whyTitle: Size or weight, whichever is more
common.sizePrice.whyRule: A box counts by its size as length × width × height in centimetres, divided by 7,875: a box of 45 × 35 × 25 cm counts as 5 kg. The price is set by whichever is more — what it weighs, or what it counts as by its size — because a big, light box takes room in the bag that nothing else can use. The road part of the price is the kilometres × a driver’s rate per kilometre × what it counts as, divided by 5.
